Warp Finance is a DeFi lending protocol that operates on the Ethereum blockchain. Warp Finance enables users to lend and borrow crypto assets through smart contracts without an intermediary. Warp Finance suffered a flash loan exploit in December 2020 that manipulated the price of its liquidity pool tokens.

Alpha Homora is a leveraged yield farming protocol that operates on the Ethereum blockchain. Alpha Homora allows users to borrow funds to increase their liquidity provision positions on automated market maker exchanges. Alpha Homora was exploited in February 2021, resulting in a loss of funds from its contracts.

Smart Contract Cover is a decentralized insurance protocol that provides coverage against smart contract failures. Smart Contract Cover is built on smart contracts on public blockchains and operates without a central insurer.

DeFiRanger is a DeFi portfolio tracking tool that aggregates a user's positions across multiple decentralized finance protocols. DeFiRanger operates as a software application built on public blockchain data rather than as a financial intermediary.
